{{quote|To stand against the Shadow so long as iron is hard and stone abides. To defend the Malkieri while one drop of blood remains. To avenge what cannot be defended.|Oath of a Malkieri Battle Lord}}

'''Dai Shan''' is a title from lost [[Malkier]] and known throughout the [[Borderlands]].

In the [[List of Old Tongue words|Old Tongue]], "dai shan" means "battle lord." In the Borderlands, [[Lan Mandragoran]] is often called Dai Shan.{{ref/book|0|15}} Lord [[Agelmar Jagad]] explains that when Lan was a baby, his parents anointed his head with oil and named him Dai Shan, a Diademed Battle Lord.{{ref/book|1|47}} It is not known if all kings of Malkier are titled Dai Shan.
